import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 205, M = N * N;
    static int[] prev = new int[M], mark = new int[N], head = new int[N], from = new int[M], cap = new int[M], to = new int[M], a = new int[N][N], b = new int[N][N], red = new int[N][N], block = new int[N][N], dis = new int[N][N], dred = new int[N], seen = new int[N];
    static Pair[] q = new Pair[N * N];
    static int[] dx = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static int[] dy = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int ec = 0;

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int f, int s) {
            this.first = f;
            this.second = s;
        }
    }

    static int readInt(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        return Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int uv, int vu) {
        from[ec] = u; to[ec] = v; cap[ec] = uv; prev[ec] = head[u]; head[u] = ec++;
        from[ec] = v; to[ec] = u; cap[ec] = vu; prev[ec] = head[v]; head[v] = ec++;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int sink, int flow) {
        if (v == sink) return flow;
        if (mark[v] != 0) return 0;
        mark[v]++;
        for (int e = head[v]; e != -1; e = prev[e]) {
            if (cap[e] > 0) {
                int u = to[e];
                int x = dfs(u, sink, Math.min(flow, cap[e]));
                if (x > 0) {
                    cap[e] -= x;
                    cap[e ^ 1] += x;
                    return x;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
        int res = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(mark, 0);
            int add = dfs(source, sink, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            if (add == 0) break;
            res += add;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int dt = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
            dis[i][i] = 0;
        }

        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(y);
                if (ch == 'Y') block[x][y] = 1;
                else if (ch == 'Z') red[x][y] = 1;
                else a[x][y] = ch - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(y);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    b[x][y] = ch - '0';
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int i = x + dx[d], j = y + dy[d];
                        if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < n && j < n && block[i][j] == 0 && red[i][j] == 0) {
                            dis[x * n + y][i * n + j] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int m = n * n;
        for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    if (dis[i][k] + dis[k][j] < dis[i][j]) {
                        dis[i][j] = dis[i][k] + dis[k][j];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int h = 0, t = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) Arrays.fill(dred, Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (red[i][j] == 1) {
                    q[t++] = new Pair(i, j);
                    dred[i * n + j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        while (h != t) {
            Pair cur = q[h++];
            int x = cur.first, y = cur.second;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int i = x + dx[d], j = y + dy[d], id = i * n + j;
                if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < n && j < n && block[i][j] == 0 && red[i][j] == 0 && dred[id] > 1000000000) {
                    dred[id] = dred[x * n + y] + 1;
                    q[t++] = new Pair(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        int sink = N - 1, source = N - 2;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
            h = 0; t = 0;
            int sx = i / n, sy = i % n;
            if (block[sx][sy] == 1 || red[sx][sy] == 1) continue;
            q[t++] = new Pair(sx, sy);
            seen[i] = 1;
            while (h != t) {
                Pair pnt = q[h++];
                int x = pnt.first, y = pnt.second;
                int id = x * n + y;
                if (dis[i][id] <= dt)
                    addEdge(i << 1, (id << 1) | 1, 1000, 0);
                if (dis[i][id] == dred[id]) continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int i2 = x + dx[d], j2 = y + dy[d], id2 = i2 * n + j2;
                    if (i2 >= 0 && j2 >= 0 && i2 < n && j2 < n && block[i2][j2] == 0 && red[i2][j2] == 0 && dis[i][id2] <= dred[id2] && dis[i][id2] <= dt && dis[i][id2] > dis[i][id] && seen[id2] == 0) {
                        q[t++] = new Pair(i2, j2);
                        seen[id2] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            addEdge(source, i << 1, a[i / n][i % n], 0);
            addEdge(i << 1 | 1, sink, b[i / n][i % n], 0);
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow(source, sink));
    }
}
